title: Maximal Gaps for Dilated Lacunary Integer Sequences
summary: Let \((a_n)_{n\ge1}\subset\mathbb{N}\) be a lacunary sequence, \(a_{n+1}\ge q a_n\) for \(q>1\). For \(x\in\mathbb{T}\), we study the maximal empty circular gap \(G_N(x)\) of the finite orbit \(\{a_1x,\ldots,a_Nx\}\). We prove that, for Lebesgue-almost every \(x\), \[ \frac{1}{2} \le \liminf_{N\to\infty}\frac{NG_N(x)}{\log N} \le \limsup_{N\to\infty}\frac{NG_N(x)}{\log N} \le \frac{q+1}{q-1}\,. \] If, in addition, \(a_n\mid a_{n+1}\) for every \(n\), then this can be improved to \[ \lim_{N\to\infty}\frac{NG_N(x)}{\log N}=1 \] for Lebesgue-almost every \(x\).
